description: Dual Hierarchy Decomposition Tree Pro Convergent Business Technologies · Pro · Freemium with 1-month free trial Dual Hierarchy Decomposition Tree Pro presents KPIs in an interactive tree with DAX-driven font colors and icons at every node. Two independent hierarchy axes drill horizontally (e.g., geography) and vertically (e.g., product), or use either axis on its own. Pro extends conditional formatting beyond status colors to per-KPI font colors and icons, evaluated at every card. The visual is a free download with full free-tier functionality; Pro unlocks via Microsoft AppSource subscription, with a one-month free trial. Key Capabilities Bi-Directional Tree Layout — Expand hierarchies horizontally and vertically within a single visual, or use either axis on its own. Up to 4 KPIs per Card — Display up to four KPI measures per card with automatic aggregation on parent nodes. DAX-Driven Status Bar — Drive the card status bar color from a DAX measure returning hex codes for traffic-light indicators and threshold logic. Per-KPI Font Colors (Pro) — Drive the font color of each KPI value independently from DAX, evaluated at every card's scope for granular conditional formatting. Per-KPI Icons (Pro) — Render icons next to each KPI value driven by DAX, with 10 built-in shapes and inline hex color overrides for brand-aligned indicators.
